definition: Bob van Luijt (born November 15, 1985), is a Dutch technology entrepreneur, technologist, and angel investor.
details: Created the open-source AI-native vector database Weaviate for hybrid search and retrieval-augmented applications. He is the co-founder and CEO of Weaviate, an open-source vector database. Van Luijt’s work focuses on the intersection of language, music, and digital infrastructure.
